final_message:
DONE

I've built the October 2025 monthly report as a 9-slide PowerPoint in the order the assignment sets out, from the title slide to Annex A. Each slide has speaker notes saying which input it came from. I couldn't open it to check the layout because LibreOffice isn't installed here, so text may run over in the more crowded tables (slides 4, 6 and 7). Check those in PowerPoint before it goes out.

**Where the project stands**

| | Status | Position |
|---|---|---|
| Delivery | Green | WP1 is on schedule. Output 1 V2.0 is due 3 Nov and goes to the assessor (Professor Dodge) on 7 Nov. WP2 starts in the week of 3 Nov as planned. |
| Spend | Amber | £10,298.70 spent against a budget to date of £9,874.37, so £424.33 (4.3%) over. £19,324.40 (65.2%) of the £29,623.10 budget remains. |
| Risk | Green | All four risks are Low likelihood after mitigation. The concern about extracting data from Common Ground Bikes' SpinBits database was cleared on 6 Oct, and no new risks were raised. |

The overspend is all in staff time. Month 1 was £1,044.17 over budget; month 2 came in £619.83 under, which brought the total down to £424.33. I recalculated these figures from the raw days and the rate card, and they match the workbook.

**Problems in the inputs, shown in the deck rather than corrected silently**
- **Spend workbook:** the "Current project costs" sheet takes each role's days from the row above (the CTO gets the CEO's days, and so on), so I didn't use it. The overhead label says £6,826.50, but the formula gives £6,836.10.
- **Budget method:** the workbook spreads the budget evenly at one-sixth per month. Overhead is a flat monthly charge rather than 30% of actual costs. I put both points to the assessor as questions on slide 8.
- **Output 1 dates:** the project log has it going to the assessor on 7 Nov, but Common Ground Bikes' comments aren't due to be added until 9 Nov. The deck proposes issuing on 7 Nov and sending a final version by 10 Nov. That date is my suggestion for the assessor to agree; it isn't in the log.
- **Risk register:**
  - It has no owner, date or status fields, so the October status on slide 6 comes from the project log.
  - The log files the SpinBits concern under risk 4, but the register's description of risk 4 is about user expectations.

**Assumptions, stated in the deck**
- The spend review is dated 3 Nov, after the report date. I counted the week of 27 Oct, including 30–31 Oct, as month 2 actuals.
- The log doesn't name an owner for starting WP2. I've put the Engineering Manager (Jeff) and marked it as assumed.
- The log doesn't say whether the SpinBits trial licence was obtained. I've listed it as an open action.
- I used only the four files in `reference_files/`. There was no `workspace/` folder, record registry or `attachments/` folder, and I couldn't open the funding website because there is no internet access.

Files are in `outputs/`:
- BridgeMind_AI_POC_Monthly_Project_Report_October_2025.pptx
